notes: The full-screen task timer now has Pause, Cancel, Log & stop and Finish.

Cancel throws the session away. Nothing is logged, and if any time was banked part-way through that sitting it is taken back out too, so a cancelled session leaves no trace on your totals or on the task's progress. It asks first and tells you how much is about to go, because there is no undo.
The separate "Log progress" button is gone. Stopping still logs your time exactly as before — that never depended on it.
